verdict.rationale: Mem0 is an API platform, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no versioned API scheme and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI spec probe and the graph-memory note that 'earlier versions' used an external graph store are a spec and a migration note, not a versioning or deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
